businessGoal: To allow visitors to view detailed information about a product.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the product information (image, name, description, price, category badge, brand badge) is displayed on the product detail page.
Verify that a section with related products is displayed below the main product information on the product detail page.
Verify that each related product is clickable and navigates to its respective detail page.

manual.reason: The acceptance criteria detail user interactions and visible information on the product detail page.

api.reason: There is no mention of APIs or backend validation in the acceptance criteria.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe specific visual elements and user interactions on the UI.
